view: straight top-down (orthographic-looking) view of a 4-way street intersection; image up = "north" (vehicles drive on the ground plane, which faces the camera). No perspective visible: identical props (lamps, planters) have identical pixel sizes everywhere in the frame.

camera.method: phase correlation of three sidewalk patches vs frame 0 (scripts/check.py)

pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left of the 2160x1080 frame

van.description: white van / minibus (long white roof, dark windshield at the top end), left (west) lane of the north-south road; drives straight north (image up)
van.occluded: never; fully inside frame in all frames
van.reference_point: ccx, ccy = centre of the min-area rectangle of the white-body colour mask

pixel_size_median.note: white body only; background-difference mask gives ~234 x 87-88 (includes mirrors / soft shadow). Front grey bumper may add ~2-4 px.

van.heading: north (image up), axis vertical (90 deg) the whole clip, x constant at 831 +-0.5

sedan.description: tan / beige (light orange) sedan, starts in the right (east) lane of the north-south road next to the van, makes a right turn and ends driving east (image right) on the east-west road
sedan.occluded: never; fully inside frame in all frames
sedan.reference_point: ccx, ccy = centre of the min-area rectangle of the tan colour mask

pixel_size_median.note: colour mask; difference mask gives ~219-221 x 83-87

sedan.heading: north at frames 0-2 (axis 90 deg), turning right through north-east (axis 135 deg at ~frame 29) to east (axis 0/180 deg) from ~frame 61

events.what: both vehicles at rest-looking start; frames 0 and 1 identical positions
sedan starts moving (~6.9 px/frame immediately, then roughly constant px/frame for the whole clip); van starts creeping forward (frame-to-frame centre steps 1-2 px at frames 2-7, noisy +-1 px)
sedan heading begins to rotate (right turn)
sedan heading ~45 deg (half-way through the turn)
sedan heading reaches due east; turn complete (rotation slows gradually from ~frame 50, so the exact end is +-3 frames)
van front edge (top of mask, y=750) crosses the line of the southern sidewalk edge (y~755) into the intersection box
clip ends; van still accelerating (step ~20 px/frame), front at y=81; sedan front ~ x 1482

events.note: van speeds up steadily over the whole clip (per-frame step grows from ~1 to ~20 px); no stop, no contact between vehicles; no bounce/impact events

road_layout.sidewalk_blocks: four beige corner blocks: NW x0-615 y0-287, NE x1081-2160 y0-287, SW x0-615 y755-1080, SE x1081-2160 y755-1080; rounded corners; thin darker curb rim

white_ball.where: on the east-west road, right side of frame, north half

rock_pile.where: grey cluster of stones on the east-west road at right edge

street_lamps_3head.note: top view of lamp posts with 3 round heads (dark grey); 8 of them along the sidewalks
street_lamps_3head.extent_px: heads span ~57-75 x 57 px depending on arm orientation

hydrant_like_props.note: small dark grey/metal props near the sidewalk corners (fire hydrant or bollard seen from above)

planter_squares_brown.note: brownish square patches (tree pits / planters) on the sidewalk, ~82 x 80 px

dark_grate_square.where: NE sidewalk near top edge, dark grey square with reddish rim

small_teal_object.where: SE sidewalk, just left of SE_lamp1 (small round bin / bollard top)
